Current status: **R19 whole capture succeeded; fresh independent review9 and whole protected qualification remain pending.**

The one source-bound [R19 capture run 39288538561, attempt 1](https://github.com/Kgray44/treasurehuntSoT/actions/runs/39288538561) completed SUCCESS against this exact candidate/base. Custody and preparation passed; focused verification and Mainline Decision were skipped as required for capture mode. Independent GitHub metadata readback found one matching dispatch and three provider artifact digests matching the native coordinator’s reported original-ZIP custody. The coordinator separately reports CRC, plan, all 368 capture artifact hashes and 424 encrypted raw-file bindings verified. Cloud has not received or independently rehashed those original ZIP bytes. R19 currently contains only the durable prepare reservation; installed authority creates later capture/review seals during authenticated review. No review9 acceptance, authenticated submission, ordinary/replay qualification, qualified seal or merge is claimed. PR #721 stays frozen/draft while the existing native reviewer completes the whole current review; #722 and dependent integrations remain held.

The adoption/admission and earlier finite-attempt receipts below are historical evidence; pre-dispatch namespace observations describe that observation time.

PR #721 now points to [`b55f5a32b7a6c42ba309db756f944e50145de123`](https://github.com/Kgray44/treasurehuntSoT/commit/b55f5a32b7a6c42ba309db756f944e50145de123), tree `fd8f252e7830ac1628011e7c5eb2ec75864cebe8`, with ordered parents frozen repair `6d0104bc02f95113d41735d845c44f4e2d0a29d0` and accepted protected main `f6af0b0e151f15f1a23808413ccee531b9827ca7`. The reviewed product repair is preserved while adopting the normally merged [R19 installer #774](https://github.com/Kgray44/treasurehuntSoT/pull/774). Its [protected run 39274717037 attempt 2](https://github.com/Kgray44/treasurehuntSoT/actions/runs/39274717037/attempts/2) succeeded; those maintenance checks establish authority installation, not Crossdeck acceptance.

The unchanged installed production default loader passed nonconsuming `experienceEvidenceRequired:false` admission against the exact current tuple. Source digest is `35a5852d762587cd3b9dd6f08142621e3e8bb81e1483287f452504dd896ddba9`; contract digest remains `befbdf5fa900b58f2a706c94a80861bb1819fbb045c17bb00756fa83b9b4af3d`; R19 record digest is `b7e78299dc6eadce6081802656b4d584eed9837df5b35a18c0dc0dbe8c789a5b`. Admission confirms seven contracts, 32 generic + six paired contexts, 291 unit files, eight technical browser suites and all eight groups / thirteen complete commands. Current pre-capture identities and the complete future 26-JSON publication projection were verified separately; the actual future provider plan must still match. The first local admission failed because one published Git JSON object was absent from the isolated cloud store; that original failure was preserved, the exact object was hash-verified locally, and the separately reviewed second nonconsuming check passed with unchanged source/index/refs. No finite invocation occurred in either local check.

The [automatic draft event 39284697514](https://github.com/Kgray44/treasurehuntSoT/actions/runs/39284697514) is completed/skipped with all four jobs skipped. R19 namespace is empty at handoff preflight; cloud has dispatched no capture. The existing native coordinator owns the single authenticated capture and original-artifact custody. Fresh whole capture, honest independent review9 / iteration13 with same-contract resolution of both prior blockers, authenticated submission, technical/ordinary/replay obligations, exact qualified seal, protected merge and landed verification remain required. Failed R18 stays spent; blocked R17 review8 and every original receipt remain preserved. The unchanged >=280 x 211 px gate, all eight technical suites, original expiry and zero rerun/refund/paid-provider budgets remain intact. PR #722 and dependent spatial acceptance stay held.

The earlier repair and historical receipt narrative below is retained as history; its former candidate/base identities are superseded by the exact R19 tuple above.

The existing #721 branch now points to [`6d0104bc02f95113d41735d845c44f4e2d0a29d0`](https://github.com/Kgray44/treasurehuntSoT/commit/6d0104bc02f95113d41735d845c44f4e2d0a29d0), tree `ac0accfb48682a825df55d940207ae16be9af297`, a normal child of `92320687dad4a246124af2e7064918cd349b738c`. [R18 capture 39192951399](https://github.com/Kgray44/treasurehuntSoT/actions/runs/39192951399) failed the real returned-phone reading check: 203.841 px high against the unchanged 211 px minimum. Its preparation `5f5e20a569da59eb92a5e38b3a56e6ddcdcb4981` is consumed. The partial staging, logs, original artifacts and prior blocked R17 review remain preserved. No R18 review9, authenticated submission, ordinary qualification or qualified seal exists.

This correction changes two files. The 381–430 px portrait Journal header shares structural grid rows, preserves full control/status labels and reflows the objective tray to give the book more room. Desktop drawer-lane and other viewport source stays as reviewed. The existing continuation test now waits for the settled current primary page, or actual reduced/fallback article, before scrolling; the recorded stale-clone detachment remains preserved. Reading geometry, time limits, progression and revocation assertions are intact.

Focused development verification passed the exact final production build with type checking, three registered normal/reduced/recovery cases, a separate normal-motion font-stress case, six portrait/landscape/restoration viewport checks, actual AX and physical keyboard checks, expanded connected options and one failed-send/retry flow. All used zero retries. The corrected UI's recorded DejaVu returned-phone bands were 240.779 and 230.299 px, with a minimum 19.299 px margin above 211; this is local font-variation evidence, not hosted-font equivalence. The separate landscape animation timeout is retained; a later independent viewport case passed the same predicate and 15-second bound. A reverse-offer diagnostic lacked the required custody transfer and is not reported as a passed incoming-phone case. Supplemental probe failures remain preserved. Independent source review and focused visual review found no confirmed blocker; owned cleanup and source conservation passed.

These are development results, not whole-experience acceptance. A separately reviewed and protected source-bound successor must precede any fresh capture. Current full capture, independent whole-experience review9, authenticated submission, all eight technical suites, trusted replay, exact qualified seal, whole Mainline Decision, protected merge and landed verification remain required. Preserve R18 consumption, all historical rows/counters/pins and the original expiry; no rerun/refund or historical acceptance reuse is claimed. Existing #722 and dependent spatial integration remain held until Crossdeck's protected merge and landed verification pass.
